taiwan.br: Fulong (beach, beginner-intermediate, Nov-Mar); Jinzun at Taitung (point, intermediate, Nov-Mar); Jialeshui at Kenting (beach, beginner, Apr-Oct)
taiwan.tp: 68-84 F, boardshorts in the south, 3/2 mm wetsuit in winter
taiwan.pm: The main beach at Fulong charges an access fee; the better surf is reported on the free side

tasmania.br: Clifton Beach (beach, beginner-intermediate, year-round); Shipstern Bluff (reef, expert, Apr-Sep); Marion Bay (beach, intermediate, Apr-Sep)
tasmania.sz: 3-6 ft; 20+ ft at Shipstern Bluff on big days

belize.br: Glover's Reef at Long Caye (point, intermediate-expert, Nov-Mar)
belize.hz: Hard coral rubble bottom, onshore chop, boat-only access, hurricane season from August to September
belize.sz: 3-4 ft; up to 6-8 ft on the biggest sets
belize.pm: The Glover's Reef operator limits board surfing to experienced guests and bars children under 12 from boards

chicago.br: Montrose Beach (beach, intermediate, Oct-Apr); 57th Street Beach (beach, intermediate, Oct-Apr)
chicago.pm: Surfing is allowed only at designated beaches such as Montrose in season, and a surfer was arrested for surfing an unauthorized beach in 2012; check the current Chicago Park District rules
src: https://www.surfrider.org/campaigns/Surfing is Not a Crime in Chicago

croatia.hz: Wind-driven short-period waves, sudden bora and jugo storms

athens.br: Vouliagmeni (beach, beginner-intermediate, Dec-Mar); Varkiza (beach, beginner, Dec-Mar)
athens.hz: Urchins, rips, undertow, rocks and buoys at Vouliagmeni, crowded when it works, strong summer meltemi wind

dubai.br: Jumeirah Beach and Sunset Beach (beach, beginner-intermediate, Nov-Mar)
dubai.hz: Short-period shamal wind swell, strong winds, offshore wave warnings during shamal storms
dubai.sz: 2-4 ft; up to 6 ft in shamal storms
dubai.tp: 75-93 F, boardshorts, a shorty at most in winter

nice-riviera.hz: Pollution, rips and boulders, short rides, flat most of the summer
nice-riviera.tp: 55-79 F, boardshorts in summer, 3/2 mm wetsuit in winter

provence.br: Sausset-les-Pins (reef, beginner-intermediate, Oct-May); Carro near Martigues (beach, intermediate, Oct-May); Épluchure beach in Marseille (beach, beginner, Oct-May)
provence.hz: Rocky pebble reef, crowded when it works, wind and mistral, short-period waves
provence.tp: 55-79 F, boardshorts in summer, 3/2 to 4/3 mm wetsuit in winter

gbr.hz: Marine stingers from November to May, crocodiles, inconsistent breaks, long boat trips to the outer-reef waves
